dict.string: Phone App Analyzer needs camera access to analyze camera-using apps and demonstrate permission controls.
Phone App Analyzer needs microphone access to analyze audio-using apps and demonstrate permission controls.
Phone App Analyzer needs location access to analyze location-tracking apps on your device.
Phone App Analyzer needs always-on location access to fully analyze location-tracking behavior of installed apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs always-on location access to monitor location-tracking apps in the background.
Phone App Analyzer needs contacts access to analyze which apps can read your contact list.
Phone App Analyzer needs photo library access to analyze storage usage and photo-accessing apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs permission to save analysis reports to your photo library.
Phone App Analyzer needs calendar access to analyze calendar-integrated apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs full calendar access to analyze calendar-integrated apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs reminders access to analyze reminder-integrated apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs full reminders access to analyze reminder-integrated apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs Bluetooth access to detect Bluetooth-connected apps and peripherals.
Phone App Analyzer needs Bluetooth peripheral access for device analysis.
Phone App Analyzer needs motion data access to analyze fitness and motion-tracking apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs to read health data to analyze which apps access your health information.
Phone App Analyzer needs to write health data to demonstrate health permission controls.
Phone App Analyzer needs speech recognition access to analyze voice-enabled apps.
Phone App Analyzer uses Face ID to secure access to your app analysis data.
Phone App Analyzer needs media library access to analyze music and media apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs NFC access to analyze NFC-capable apps.
Phone App Analyzer needs local network access to analyze network-connected apps.
Phone App Analyzer uses this to demonstrate app tracking transparency controls.
